objects.taxonomy_description: A small, flat, baked food item typically characterized by a round shape and textured surface, distinct from cakes or breads.

diagnostic_checkpoints.Surface_Texture: The surface appears dry, crumbly, or slightly cracked, lacking the smooth frosting or soft sponge texture of cakes.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Coloration: The item displays uniform golden-brown to dark-brown hues consistent with baked dough, without the pale interior of raw dough or bread.
diagnostic_checkpoints.Scale_and_Context: The object is small enough to be held in one hand and lacks the structural complexity or size of larger baked goods like pies or loaves.

objects.taxonomy_description: Stringed instrument with solid or semi-hollow body (no sound hole required). Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway, contoured edges), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body). Body is wood (alder, mahogany, maple) with glossy polyester or nitrocellulose finish in solid colors, sunburst, or natural wood grain. Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard (rosewood or maple, 21-24 frets). Pickups (magnetic, 1-3) mounted on body. Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch. Bridge is fixed or tremolo. Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Solid or semi-hollow body with no sound hole required.
Body shape varies: Stratocaster (double-cutaway), Les Paul (single-cutaway, carved top), Telecaster (single-cutaway, slab body).
Neck is maple or mahogany with fretted fingerboard with numerous frets.
Functional_Components: Control knobs (volume, tone) and pickup selector switch.
Headstock has 6 tuning pegs. Cable jack on body edge.
